SELECT
  ub.booking_status,
  COUNT(*) AS booking_count
FROM idb_database.USER_BOOKINGS ub
GROUP BY ub.booking_status
ORDER BY booking_count DESC;

SELECT
  p.pm_gateway_name,
  ROUND(SUM(p.pm_amount), 2) AS total_payment_amount
FROM idb_database.PAYMENTS p
GROUP BY p.pm_gateway_name
ORDER BY total_payment_amount DESC;

SELECT
  ub.booking_source,
  COUNT(*) AS total_bookings
FROM idb_database.USER_BOOKINGS ub
GROUP BY ub.booking_source
ORDER BY total_bookings DESC;

SELECT
  ub.hotel_id,
  ROUND(SUM(ub.booking_amount), 2) AS total_booking_amount
FROM idb_database.USER_BOOKINGS ub
GROUP BY ub.hotel_id
ORDER BY total_booking_amount DESC;

SELECT
  bf.hotel_id,
  ROUND(SUM(bf.fee_value), 2) AS total_booking_fees
FROM idb_database.BOOKING_FEES bf
GROUP BY bf.hotel_id
ORDER BY total_booking_fees DESC;

SELECT
  rr.room_type,
  COUNT(*) AS reservation_count
FROM idb_database.ROOM_RESERVATIONS rr
GROUP BY rr.room_type
ORDER BY reservation_count DESC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(ub.booking_amount), 2) AS average_booking_amount
FROM idb_database.USER_BOOKINGS ub;

SELECT
  apm.id,
  apm.group_id,
  apm.payment_method_type,
  apm.card_type,
  apm.card_issuer,
  apm.card_last4,
  apm.card_exp_date,
  apm.ach_account_type,
  apm.ach_account_last4,
  apm.active
FROM idb_database.ACCOUNT_PAYMENT_METHODS apm;

SELECT
  idb_database.HOTEL_TAXES.id,
  idb_database.HOTEL_TAXES.hotel_id,
  idb_database.HOTEL_TAXES.tax_name,
  idb_database.HOTEL_TAXES.tax_percentage,
  idb_database.HOTEL_TAXES.tax_province
FROM idb_database.HOTEL_TAXES
ORDER BY idb_database.HOTEL_TAXES.hotel_id,
         idb_database.HOTEL_TAXES.tax_name;

SELECT
  hf.hotel_id,
  hf.fee_name,
  hf.fee_value,
  hf.fee_type,
  hf.value_type,
  hf.only_be,
  hf.is_cc_processing_fee
FROM idb_database.HOTEL_FEES hf
ORDER BY hf.hotel_id, hf.fee_name;

SELECT
    uc.id,
    uc.hotel_id,
    uc.booking_amount,
    uc.cancel_charge,
    uc.cancel_taxes,
    uc.refund,
    uc.cancel_date,
    uc.cancel_by,
    uc.user_email,
    uc.policy_name,
    uc.policy_desc
FROM idb_database.USER_CANCELLATIONS uc
ORDER BY uc.cancel_date DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  hs.hotel_id,
  hs.booking_id,
  hs.service_description,
  hs.service_amount,
  hs.service_date
FROM idb_database.HOTEL_SERVICES hs
ORDER BY hs.service_date DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  gm.user_name,
  gm.email,
  ub.booking_amount
FROM idb_database.GUEST_MAPPING gm
JOIN idb_database.USER_BOOKINGS ub
  ON gm.booking_id = ub.id
ORDER BY ub.booking_amount DESC;

SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    o.hotel_id,
    o.shop_id,
    o.order_date,
    o.order_status,
    o.order_amount,
    od.id AS order_item_id,
    od.product_id,
    od.product_name,
    od.product_qty,
    od.product_price,
    od.product_discount,
    od.product_tax_perc,
    od.item_type
FROM idb_database.ORDERS o
JOIN idb_database.ORDER_DETAIL od
    ON od.order_id = o.id
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  ub.id AS booking_id,
  ub.booking_amount,
  bt.tax_name,
  bt.tax_value
FROM idb_database.USER_BOOKINGS ub
JOIN idb_database.BOOKING_TAXES bt
  ON bt.booking_id = ub.id
ORDER BY ub.booking_amount DESC;

SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(ub.booking_made_on / 1000), '%Y-%m') AS booking_month,
  COUNT(*) AS total_bookings
FROM idb_database.USER_BOOKINGS ub
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(ub.booking_made_on / 1000), '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY booking_month;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS hotel_count
FROM idb_database.HOTEL;

SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(al.date, '%Y-%m') AS billing_month,
  SUM(al.amount) AS total_billing_amount
FROM idb_database.ACCOUNTS a
JOIN idb_database.ACCOUNT_LEDGER al
  ON a.group_id = al.group_id
WHERE a.billing_address_country = 'India'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(al.date, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY billing_month;

SELECT
    h.id AS hotel_id,
    h.name AS hotel_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ub.booking_amount), 2) AS total_booking_revenue_2025
FROM idb_database.USER_BOOKINGS ub
JOIN idb_database.HOTEL h
    ON h.id = ub.hotel_id
WHERE ub.booking_made_on >= 1735689600
  AND ub.booking_made_on < 1767225600
GROUP BY h.id, h.name
ORDER BY total_booking_revenue_2025 DESC;
